events.name: vehicle_selector_started
events.trigger: First Year/Make/Model choice made in the vehicle selector

events.name: vehicle_selector_submitted
events.trigger: Vehicle selector submitted with Year, Make and Model chosen

events.name: vehicle_selector_abandoned
events.trigger: Page hidden after the selector was started and never submitted

events.name: homepage_video_watched
events.trigger: First unique homepage video review played

events.name: homepage_videos_multiple
events.trigger: Second unique homepage video review played

events.name: homepage_videos_five_or_more
events.trigger: Fifth unique homepage video review played

events.name: switched_to_photo_reviews
events.trigger: Photo Reviews tab opened when it was not already active

segments.name: Started, did not submit
segments.conditions: Has done vehicle_selector_abandoned and has not done vehicle_selector_submitted since that abandon

segments.name: Submitted
segments.conditions: Has done vehicle_selector_submitted at least once

segments.name: Heavy video and review consumption
segments.conditions: Has done homepage_videos_five_or_more AND has done switched_to_photo_reviews in the last 30 days
